title: A radiographic world model for clinical reasoning and evidence generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07719v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical imaging artificial intelligence (AI) is commonly developed as separate mappings from radiographs to diagnostic outputs or from clinical descriptions to generated images, although both arise from the same underlying radiographic state. A world-model formulation instead seeks to learn an internal representation of this state that can support both clinical readout and conditional simulation of radiographic observations. Here we introduce MedDream, a radiographic world model that learns a shared continuous latent state from paired chest radiograph-text observations for diagnostic reasoning and report-conditioned evidence generation. MedDream was pretrained on 2.65 million leakage-controlled chest radiograph-text pairs curated from 4.40 million candidates. translated_title: 一种用于临床推理与证据生成的放射影像世界模型
translated_abstract: 医学影像人工智能（AI）通常被开发为两种相互独立的映射：从放射影像到诊断输出，或从临床描述到生成图像，尽管两者都源于同一个潜在的放射影像状态。世界模型的构建方式则旨在学习这一状态的内部表示，从而同时支持临床读片判读和放射影像观察的条件化模拟。在此，我们提出MedDream——一种放射影像世界模型，它从胸部放射影像-文本配对观测中学习共享的连续潜在状态，用于诊断推理和基于报告条件的证据生成。MedDream在从440万候选样本中精心筛选出的265万个经数据泄漏控制的胸部放射影像-文本配对数据上进行了预训练。在八个临床数据集和两个独立阅片者队列中，MedDream的表现均优于领先的诊断模型和生成式对比模型。在诊断推理方面，MedDream显示出……
tldr: MedDream是一种放射影像世界模型，通过从胸部X光影像-文本配对数据中学习共享潜在状态，可同时支持诊断推理和基于报告条件的影像证据生成，并在多项临床数据集和独立阅片者队列中超越了领先的诊断与生成式模型。
en_tdlr: MedDream is a radiographic world model that learns a shared latent state from paired chest radiograph-text data, enabling both diagnostic reasoning and report-conditioned evidence generation, and outperforms leading diagnostic and generative baselines across multiple clinical datasets and independent reader cohorts.
